summary: Distribution Solutions Group filed an 8-K disclosing that its wholly owned subsidiary Lawson Products entered an Agreement and Plan of Merger on October 12, 2026 to acquire GradeEight Holdings, LLC for approximately $145 million, subject to customary adjustments, via a reverse merger of a Lawson merger sub into GradeEight, which survives as a wholly owned Lawson subsidiary. No financing condition applies; the purchase price will be funded with revolver borrowings and cash. The filing also notes a separate July 15, 2026 merger with Eclipse/LKCM Headwater affiliates, which hold roughly 78.5% of DSG, implying a going-private overhang that remains the key arbitrage variable.
